parsed.note_markdown:
### RF — Broad earnings improvement with healthier credit

**Reported GAAP diluted EPS increased to $0.71 from $0.64 sequentially**, while adjusted EPS rose from $0.68 to $0.73. Net income available to common shareholders advanced to $611 million from $549 million [B0017–B0020]. The adjusted comparison excludes the bank's identified non-GAAP adjustments rather than treating reported and underlying results as interchangeable.

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII increased $21 million to $1,298 million, and FTE NIM expanded 2 basis points to 3.68%. Noninterest income rose to $675 million from $630 million, supported by capital markets and other fee categories. Noninterest expense edged down to $1,118 million from $1,121 million, improving the reported efficiency ratio to 56.2% from 58.3% [B0051, B0054, B0066, B0059, B0091, B0040].

**Credit:** Provision remained steady at $68 million, while net charge-offs declined to $72 million from $102 million. The annualized charge-off ratio improved to 0.29% from 0.42%. ACL coverage stood at 1.61% [B0167–B0169, B0164].

**Capital and returns:** Estimated CET1 was 10.8%, reported ROTCE reached 21.27%, and tangible common book value was $12.65 per share. Share repurchases totaled $95 million [B0183, B0037, B0188, B0191].

**Guidance:** No explicit quantified revision to forward guidance was identified in the supplied release.

**Investment thesis:** Positive incremental development. Improved spread income, stronger fees, operating leverage and better credit performance reinforce Regions' profitability case.
